title: Chapter 39 — First Night-Watch
paragraphs: Ha! Ha! Ha! Ha! Ahem! Let me clear my throat! I've been thinking about it ever since, and that ha, ha is the final conclusion. Why? Because a laugh is the wisest, easiest answer to everything that's strange. And come what may, one comfort always remains — that unfailing comfort is, it's all predestined. I didn't hear all his talk with Starbuck, but to my poor eye, Starbuck looked then something like the way I felt the other evening. You can be sure the old Mogul has got him, too. I caught on, I knew it — if I'd had the gift, I could easily have prophesied it — because when I clapped my eye on his skull, I saw it. Well, Stubb, wise Stubb — that's my title — well, Stubb, what of it, Stubb? Here's a carcass. I don't know all that may be coming, but whatever it is, I'll go to meet it laughing. What a mischievous leer lurks in all your horrors! I feel funny. Fa, la! Lirra, skirra! What's my juicy little pear at home doing now? Crying its eyes out? Giving a party for the latest harpooners to arrive, I'd wager, as cheerful as a frigate's pennant, and so am I — fa, la! Lirra, skirra! Oh —
We'll drink tonight with hearts as light, To love, as gay and fleeting As bubbles that swim on the beaker's brim, And break on the lips while meeting.
A brave song that — who calls? Mr. Starbuck? Yes, yes, sir — (Aside) he's my superior, and he has his too, if I'm not mistaken. — Yes, yes, sir, just finishing this job — coming.
